theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (Λ W : ℝ), IsOpen G → IsOpen O → G ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → Continuous ω → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ x ∈ G, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Λ) → (∀ z, ‖ω z‖ ≤ W) → (∀ μ : Measure (Euclid P), AEStronglyMeasurable (G.indicator fun y => (ω (f y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f y)) μ) ∧ ∀ x, ‖G.indicator (fun y => (ω (f y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f y)) x‖ ≤ W * Λ ^ n
